dict.string: CardOnCue needs access to your camera to scan barcodes on your membership and loyalty cards. Your photos are never saved.
CardOnCue needs access to your photo library so you can import pictures of your membership and loyalty cards.
CardOnCue uses your location to find nearby stores for your cards and to remind you when a saved card is ready to use.
CardOnCue uses your location in the background to notify you when you arrive at a store where you have a saved card.
